notablePrerequisites:
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Evolving Wilds by tapping and sacrificing it.
Evolving Wilds is put on the bottom of your library instead of in your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Evolving Wilds ability, searching your library for Evolving Wilds and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Evolving Wilds enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Evolving Wilds.
Repeat.
